reference.title: Instalações de ar-condicionado — Sistemas centrais e unitários — Parte 3: Qualidade do ar interior
reference.note: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 is treated as a contextual standard reference for HVAC-related IAQ and ventilation topics. This record preserves the absence of a specific equivalent criterion for VOC Index.

parameterDefinition.name: VOC Index
parameterDefinition.description: Relative VOC index for contextual monitoring only. The consolidated dossier did not find a specific equivalent criterion in ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: Contextual index interpretation without conversion to concentration; no specific criterion identified in the consolidated ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 scope.

criteria.methodNote: NO_SPECIFIC_CRITERION_FOUND: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 does not provide a specific equivalent criterion for the VOC Index. This record does not convert VOC Index into COV/COVT, nor into ppm or µg/m³, and is not operational for direct compliance.
criteria.temporalGuidance: The VOC Index remains contextual and relative; not a concentration-based compliance criterion.

curation.curationNotes: Curated from the consolidated dossier. VOC Index is retained as a contextual relative indicator without a direct equivalent criterion under ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024.

validation.validationNotes: The dossier confirms that no specific equivalent criterion was found for VOC Index under ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024. Conversion to COV/COVT or concentration units is not supported. Independent primary-source validation remains pending.
